messages:
alex: Seeing a surge of 502s on /v1/generate in us-west-2 starting ~11:58. Error rate around 6-9%. Anyone available for a quick war-room? Need a bridge.
mira: On it, stand by — creating bridge now.
mira: Bridge up: https://meet.redwood.local/bridge/g7y2 (pin: 7724). Joining.
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0429 (channel: #eng-oncall). Severity: P2. Assigned: alex, mira, jon, sam.
jon: joining, grabbing traces + tailing runtime logs.
sam: joining, checking infra events and autoscaler. No recent infra deploys reported.
alex: quick context: traffic spike seems concentrated to a single external client test-run. Pattern looks like upstream read/kv errors rather than rate-limit rejections.
mira: quick repro with curl to reproduce 502

```\ncurl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \\\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\\n  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-7b\",\"input\":\"test\"}'\n# response headers show 502, body: \"upstream read timeout\"\n```\n
mira: logs from runtime (`kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference -c runtime --since=15m | tail -n 300`) show repeated: `ERROR runtime: kv-cache fetch error: OOM` on multiple pods.
jon: got those too. Traces show large-batch path exercised with big sequence sizes. Looks like working set blowup.
sam: infra metrics: node memory pressure spike at 11:57:12 in us-west-2b. Autoscaler started adding nodes at 11:59:45. Gap there.
jon: hypothesis: sudden large-batch workload increases KV cache working set -> evictions -> upstream read failures.
alex: immediate mitigation proposal: 1) disable large-batch runtime flag on canary pool; 2) increase replicaCount temporarily; 3) add gateway batch size cap.
mira: rolled canary change at 12:03: set `runtime.flags.large_batch=false` on canary pods.
mira: scaled inference replicas from 8 -> 14 in us-west region via helm change at 12:04.
jon: watching metrics, 502 rate falling to ~1.5% after config + scale. Nice.
alex: keep bridge open for 25m to watch. If stable we'll promote cluster-wide and schedule a post-incident review.
mira: left notes for follow-ups: add production safety limit on gateway for batch sizes, and add safer defaults for KV reservation.
sam: infra action item: tune autoscaler to trigger earlier on memory pressure (lower threshold) and consider pre-warm burst capacity in the region.
oncall-bot: INC-2026-0429 update: mitigations applied, monitoring. Will mark priority as pending stabilization.
jon: I'll assemble relevant logs and a short runbook snippet and drop into ops-runbooks/triage-kv-cache.md.
alex: thanks all. If anyone sees a regression, ping this thread. Planning a short incident follow-up tomorrow 09:30 PT (30m) to write the postmortem & assign actions.
mira: noted, monitoring dashboards look healthy. :white_check_mark:
jon: small request: add an alert for kv-cache eviction rate spike so autoscaler isn't blind to this pattern.
alex: added to backlog and will include in postmortem.
mira: closing bridge in 20m unless objections.
alex: no objections. Great work team. :coffee:
